title: Claude Field Guide
description: A practical study guide to using Claude well: every major feature of the Claude apps, Cowork, Claude Code and the API, plus prompting techniques, workflow recipes and ways to save usage.

description: A complete study guide to Docker: from what a container is to multi-stage builds, Compose, security, CI/CD and a full production-style AI service.

title: FastAPI Field Guide
description: A complete study guide to building APIs with FastAPI, testing them with Postman and Newman, and designing your own data-driven automated API testing tool.

title: MCP Field Guide
description: A beginner-friendly study guide to the Model Context Protocol: what it is, how it works, building and testing a server, connecting it to Claude and LangChain, and running it safely.

title: Pydantic Field Guide
description: A complete study guide to Pydantic v2: models, fields, validators, serialization, configuration, TypeAdapter, JSON Schema, settings, FastAPI and LLM structured output, with a full capstone project.

title: RAG Field Guide
